confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Phuket and Thai tourist pricing, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately confident; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain and assume July green-season (off-season) rates with Thai VAT and service charges included. Cocktail and wine are set at about 2.5x the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX rate comes from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA, and I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Thailand's other resort and tourist hubs (Krabi, Koh Samui, Chiang Mai, Pattaya) and Southeast Asian beach-resort pricing, adjusted for Patong, Kata and Karon accommodation in the July low season.
